name: ILI (Influenza-Like Illness) Dataset
description: Weekly influenza-like illness (ILI) patient visit percentages in the United States, paired with epidemiological data and used for time-series forecasting. The ETT (Electricity Transformer Temperature) benchmark comprises four subsets: ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, and ETTm2.
citation: Wu, H., Xu, J., Wang, J., & Long, M. (2021). Autoformer: Decomposition Transformers with Auto-Correlation for Long-Term Series Forecasting. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34 (NeurIPS 2021). https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.13008
